articleTitle: Why Reminding Your Teen About Grades Doesn't Work
imageHeadline: The more you remind, the less they care
imageSubtext: Why nagging about grades backfires with teens—and what actually works
pinTitle: Why Reminding Your Teen About Grades Doesn't Work (What Helps Instead)
pinDescription: Bright kid, no motivation to study? Research on adolescent academic motivation shows that reminders and pressure usually reduce engagement. Learn what actually supports motivation in disengaged teens—autonomy, collaboration, and praising effort over outcomes.

items.label: Ask what's actually getting in the way
Collaborate on a plan instead of imposing one
Let them choose how, when, and where to study
Praise effort and strategies, not just grades
